notes: R2 from gantt three-refactor plan. Vitest baseline green (604 tests) at HEAD 96759693, manifest ./baseline-tests.json. Playwright baseline RED at 102 known-failing specs (.gantt-gutter class missing + 27 integration specs need DB seed) — count carried forward as the new floor; any additional failure is auto-fail.

playwright_baseline.policy: Carry-forward floor — iteration failures count must be ≤ 102. Any new failing spec is auto-fail. New specs added by this refactor (column-alignment.spec.ts) must be green from their first commit; they do NOT get the carry-forward 102 floor.

frozen_x_coords.description: The four x-coordinates that pin column alignment across the page. Captured at iter 0 by the new Playwright spec e2e/specs/_harness/column-alignment.spec.ts which writes them back here. Re-verified every iteration with ±0.5 px tolerance.
frozen_x_coords.spec_status_policy: Generator authors the spec in commit 5 of the planned sequence; it must be green on first commit. The spec measures and writes the four coordinates into this slot at iter 0 (label baseline_iter0) and reads-back / asserts every subsequent iter.
frozen_x_coords.policy: At every viewport width, all four coords must be equal within ±0.5 px. Larger deviation = auto-fail.

bundle_envelope.policy: Fixed ceiling per H9. R2 is CSS-only — neutral or negative delta expected. H9 override clause requires documented sub-0.5 % structural-cost evidence; invoking it on a CSS refactor is a red flag worth a generator note.
bundle_envelope.measurement_command: cd OneMoreTaskTracker.WebClient && npm run build && find dist -name "*Gantt*.js" -o -name "*Gantt*.css" | xargs -I{} gzip -c {} | wc -c

wall_clock_envelopes.policy: Generator records both baselines at iter 0 from the iteration's own run.log; evaluator pins them and asserts subsequent iters do not exceed baseline × 1.10.

e2e_ai_envelope.policy: Iteration tokens spent must stay within the post-iter-2 envelope (see e2e-alumium harness report). DOM verbosity should not change materially under a CSS-only refactor.
